t: Three men sealed in by a rock
a: اللَّهُمَّ كَانَ لِي أَبَوَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ فَكُنْتُ لاَ أَغْبُقُ قَبْلَهُمَا أَهْلاً وَلاَ مَالاً
m: O Allah, I had two elderly parents, and I never gave milk to anyone before them, not family nor property. One day I was kept far away, and came back to find them asleep. I disliked waking them and disliked giving to anyone before them, so I stood with the vessel in my hand until dawn broke, with my children crying at my feet. If I did that seeking Your face, relieve us of this rock.
